# Dr. Mohamad El Haress, MD, FICS

> Official professional website of Dr. Mohamad El Haress, a general surgeon, minimally invasive surgeon and complex surgical oncologist in Beirut, Lebanon.

This website provides verified professional information, patient education, clinical service pages and publication summaries. Medical content is educational and does not replace an individual consultation.

## Clinical focus
- General surgery
- Complex surgical oncology
- Minimally invasive and advanced laparoscopic surgery
- Gastrointestinal surgery
- Hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery
- Colorectal surgery
- Breast surgery
- Endocrine surgery
- Debulking surgery and HIPEC
- Benign gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary and general surgical conditions

## Verified professional profile
- General Surgery residency at MGH in affiliation with the American University of Beirut
- Minimally invasive and laparoscopic surgery fellowship training in New Delhi, India
- Colorectal surgery training experience at Alexandria University, Egypt
- Hepatobiliary, pancreatic and liver transplant surgery training at Greater Paris University Hospitals (AP-HP), France
- Currently completing the final year of a Complex Surgical Oncology fellowship at the American University of Beirut Medical Center
- Fellow of the International College of Surgeons (FICS)
- Associate Fellow of the American College of Surgeons
- Member of the European Society of Surgical Oncology
- Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery program completion through SAGES
- Advanced trauma certification
- Diploma in Healthcare Management for Physicians from Gates Group, accredited by TRACCERT Canada
